paite: Damaskas kho puakgik. Ngai in, Damaskas khopi hi nawn lou ding a lakmang ahita, huchi in inn chimsia koihkhawm lel ahita ding hi.
heading: Pathian In Siria Leh Israel Agawt Ding
english: The burden of Damascus: “Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it will be a ruinous heap.

paite: Aroer khote taisan in a-omta; belamhonte omna ding ahi mai ding, huaite lah a-om ngei ding ua, kuamah in alausak kei ding uh.
english: The cities of Aroer are forsaken. They will be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

paite: Ephraim a kipan kulhpi amang ding a, Damaskas a kipan gam amang ding, Siria gam a khosuaksunte leng amang ding uh; Israel suante thupina bang lel in a-om ding uh, sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi.
english: The fortress shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria. They will be as the glory of the children of Israel,” says Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, Jakob thupina hihgawn in a-om ding a, asa thauna leng ahong gawngta ding hi.
english: “It will happen in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh will become lean.

paite: Huchi in buh la pan buh alak a, avuite alak bang mai ahi ding a, ahi, Rephaim phaizang ah mi'n buh maihkhakte atom bang mai uh ahi ding hi.
english: It will be like when the harvester gathers the wheat, and his arm reaps the grain. Yes, it will be like when one gleans grain in the valley of Rephaim.

paite: Himahleh, olive singgah loh khit a azikpi dawn a gah nih hiam thum hiam om lai bang leh singgah hiang hoih li hiam nga hiam a-om sek bang in, maih khak top ding a-om lai ding, TOUPA Pathian in achi hi.
english: Yet gleanings will be left there, like the shaking of an olive tree, two or three olives in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outermost branches of a fruitful tree,” says Yahweh, the God of Israel.

paite: Huai ni chiang in mi'n a Bawlpa uh lam a-enta ding ua, amitte un Israelte Mi Siangthou azahtakta ding uh.
english: In that day, people will look to their Maker, and their eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Maitam, amau khutsuakte lam a-en nawnta kei ding ua, amau khut a bawl Asherim hiam, gimlim maitamte hiam azahtak nawnta kei ding uhi.
english: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands; neither shall they respect that which their fingers have made, either the Asherim, or the incense altars.

paite: Huai ni chiang in akhopi kiptakte uh gammang leh tang vum a mun taisansa, Israel suante ma a ataisansa bang uh, ahi ding; huchi in munloih ahita ding hi.
english: In that day, their strong cities will be like the forsaken places in the woods and on the mountain top, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel; and it will be a desolation.

paite: Nang hon hondampa Pathian na mangngilh a, na hatna Suangpi lah na theigige kei hi; huaiziak in singkung kilawm taktakte na suan ding a, asung ah hiang tuamte na vut paisuak ding hi.
english: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation, and have not remembered the rock of your strength. Therefore you plant pleasant plants, and set out foreign seedlings.

paite: Na suan ni in na khangsak a, zingsang in thil chi lah na paksak a; himahleh agahloh lah lungngaihna leh natna thupitak ni in amang hi.
english: In the day of your planting, you hedge it in. In the morning, you make your seed blossom, but the harvest flees away in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.

paite: Ah! Mipi tampi ging zuazua, tuipite ging zuazua bang a ging zuazuate leh namte husa ging hawhaw, tui thupitakte ging hawhaw bang a ging hawhawte na tung uh agik hi!
heading: Melma Namte Zoh Ahi Uh
english: Ah, the uproar of many peoples, who roar like the roaring of the seas; and the rushing of nations, that rush like the rushing of mighty waters!

paite: Namte lah tuipi tampi ging hawhaw bang in aging hawhaw ding ua; himahleh ama'n ataihilh ding a, huchi in gamlapi ah ataimang ding ua, tang a buhsi huih mut bang leh leivui huihpi mutleng lunglung bang in delh in a-om ding uhi.
english: The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters: but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be chased like the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like the whirling dust before the storm.

paite: Nitaklam in, ngai in, thil mulkimhuaitak a-om a; huan, khovak ma in lah a-om nawn kei uh. Huai gallak a hon laksak mite tan ahi a, hon guksak mite tuam leng ahi hi.
english: At evening, behold, terror! Before the morning, they are no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, and the lot of those who rob us.
